text:
Return canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, and exact activity values (type, relation, value, units) for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1613797.

Select: canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units
Source: assays, activities, compound_structures, molecule_dictionary
Join: assays.assay_id = activities.assay_id AND activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno AND molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno
Filter: assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1613797'
Limit: None
